owner_decision.decision: Scoped risk acceptance for the PyTorch findings, offline evaluation runtime only.
conditions: time-boxed to the approved evaluation windows
non-precedential for serving images or anything that touches traffic
network-isolated execution with no inbound network and egress restricted to private S3 and ECR endpoints
owner_decision.reason_not_effective: The owner requires independent review PASS and the exact packet approval phrase before execution.

immutable_subject.drift_rule: Any source, image, package, model, tokenizer, evaluation-input, finding-set or severity drift voids this acceptance before execution.

risk_method.rating_basis: Residual likelihood is assessed only after every binding control below is proven. Package severity is never downgraded; the residual rating describes this exact offline pilot context.

risks.description: A malicious PyTorch checkpoint loaded with torch.load(..., weights_only=True) can corrupt memory and may execute code in the evaluation process.
risks.attack_vector_in_general: Attacker-controlled .pth/.pt checkpoint bytes reach the weights-only unpickler.
attack_vector_absent_in_this_context_bec: The runtime has no upload, request, socket listener, Service, Ingress or other untrusted-input path.

Only the three packet-bound model identities are accepted; the Meta checkpoint SHA-256 values are 354f981756aa8f41591ea363e45b9c4eba1ec5144c2273af82e747efbb08919c and cceb4d9ebac3d168a6af6b26c62ce11bafc562b38976c6bfa87e7d60422c6da5, and the Whisper artifact tree SHA-256 is 5adf77568813513bc3697a1501ba354c04c7b93ea374fc5407cf4f6402f7431e.
Model objects are create-only in a non-serving research prefix and are SHA-256 and byte-length verified before PyTorch starts and again immediately before load.
Evaluation audio comes only from the hash-frozen PASS_INPUT_FREEZE inventory; no user or traffic input is accepted.
risks.exploitability_record: The exact fairseq2 path does call torch.load and therefore contains the vulnerable primitive. The acceptance relies on excluding attacker-controlled checkpoint bytes, not on claiming the primitive is patched or weights_only=True is sufficient.
risks.residual_failure_scenario: Compromise of the exact official model bytes before their recorded hashes were established, a SHA-256 verification defect, or a control bypass could permit code execution inside the bounded evaluation container.
risks.mitigation: Exact official-source provenance, create-only object staging, two independent SHA-256 checks, no untrusted inputs, no inbound network, S3/ECR-only egress, read-only non-root container, no PHI, deadline-first window and mandatory destruction.

risks.description: The PyTorch pt2 loading path can deserialize untrusted data and may execute code.
risks.attack_vector_in_general: A local attacker supplies a malicious .pt2 archive to torch.export.load, including a pickle-enabled weights configuration or fallback path.
attack_vector_absent_in_this_context_bec: The pilot loads no .pt2 archive and the exact in-image MedZen, Omnilingual and fairseq2 Python sources contain zero torch.export.load occurrences.
The only permitted model files are the hash-pinned .pt Meta checkpoints and the existing content-addressed Whisper CTranslate2 tree.
There is no local-user, upload, inbound-network or traffic path through which another archive can be introduced.
risks.exploitability_record: Docker Scout conservatively marks torch 2.8.0+cu128 affected with range <=2.10.0. NVD currently describes the pt2 handler in 2.10.0. This acceptance preserves the scanner's broader classification and does not use the NVD difference to suppress the finding.
risks.residual_failure_scenario: A source or dispatch change that begins calling torch.export.load, or an unbound file entering the model root, would reintroduce the attack path and must fail the static and provenance gates.
risks.mitigation: Static prohibited-API gate, exact model-format allowlist, immutable source hashes, frozen local files only, no inbound network, S3/ECR-only egress, non-root read-only execution and immediate teardown.

risks.description: A torch.compile/Inductor path combining torch.rot90 and torch.randn_like can produce incorrect tensor behavior and is classified by the scanner as an availability risk.
risks.attack_vector_in_general: Attacker-controlled execution reaches the exact compiled rot90 plus randn_like operator combination.
attack_vector_absent_in_this_context_bec: The exact evaluation adapter, Omnilingual inference pipeline and fairseq2 source contain zero torch.rot90 and zero torch.randn_like occurrences.
The evaluation entrypoint does not call torch.compile or accept model code, expressions or operator selection from input.
Frozen audio can affect tensor values only; it cannot select new Python code or a new model graph.
risks.exploitability_record: The public reproducer requires the specific compiled operator combination. That combination is absent from the bound inference path; the static gate is rerun against the exact image before every window.
risks.residual_failure_scenario: A dependency or model-code change could introduce the vulnerable combination, causing incorrect output or bounded-process failure.
risks.mitigation: Exact source and image pinning, prohibited-API static gate, frozen inputs, per-row fail-closed receipts, deadline, one container and destruction after the window.

risks.description: A torch.compile/Inductor path using torch.linalg.lu with slicing can cause denial of service.
risks.attack_vector_in_general: Attacker-controlled execution reaches a compiled torch.linalg.lu result followed by the triggering slice operation.
attack_vector_absent_in_this_context_bec: The exact evaluation adapter, Omnilingual inference pipeline and fairseq2 source contain zero torch.linalg.lu occurrences.
The evaluation entrypoint does not call torch.compile and accepts neither executable model code nor arbitrary operators.
No inbound request or user-controlled model can select this graph.
risks.exploitability_record: The public reproducer requires torch.linalg.lu and torch.compile; the bound inference path contains neither the LU operation nor an application-level compile call for this model path.
risks.residual_failure_scenario: A source or model-code drift could introduce the triggering compiled operation and terminate the bounded process.
risks.mitigation: Exact source and image pinning, prohibited-API static gate, frozen inputs, per-row fail-closed receipts, deadline and teardown.

input_and_data.model_inputs: Only exact packet-bound, create-only, SHA-256-verified model and tokenizer objects.
input_and_data.audio_inputs: Only rows selected from the twice-identical PASS_INPUT_FREEZE result; every local audio file is verified against its frozen SHA-256 before inference.
input_and_data.phi: PROHIBITED; the packet classifies the frozen public/research evaluation inputs as no-PHI and refuses if that classification cannot be proven.
input_and_data.inbound_network: PROHIBITED; no Service, Ingress, LoadBalancer, hostNetwork or listening socket is permitted.

network_isolation.current_vpc_cni: v1.22.3-eksbuild.1 with network-policy configuration currently absent
network_isolation.required_execution_mode: Enable VPC CNI network policy and NETWORK_POLICY_ENFORCING_MODE=strict before creating the evaluation workload; standard-mode startup allow is prohibited.
network_isolation.workload_shape: Controller-owned, hostNetwork=false evaluation workload with automountServiceAccountToken=false, no Pod Identity association, no Kubernetes Service and an ingress-empty NetworkPolicy.
allowed_egress: TCP/443 to the temporary private ECR API and ECR DKR interface endpoint ENI IPs
TCP/443 to the current com.amazonaws.eu-central-1.s3 managed-prefix-list CIDRs through the temporary S3 gateway endpoint
UDP/TCP 53 to the VPC resolver solely to resolve those private AWS endpoints
network_isolation.prohibited_egress: All other CIDRs, ports, public internet, IMDS, STS and general AWS APIs.
network_isolation.proof: Before importing torch, the exact workload must prove S3/ECR endpoint reachability and prove refusal to the Meta public download host, a public HTTPS control and EC2 IMDS; VPC Flow Logs and NetworkPolicyEndpoint state are retained. Any unexpected accepted flow refuses the window.
network_isolation.cleanup: Delete the evaluation workload and policies, delete temporary endpoints and their security group, restore the exact pre-window VPC CNI configuration, replace or terminate the GPU node, and prove desired capacity zero.

scan_gate.fail_closed: Any additional finding, absent expected finding, severity drift, package/version drift, incomplete scan or child-digest mismatch voids the acceptance and stops before compute.

expires_at_earliest_of: seven days after the exact owner approval timestamp
any immutable-subject, input, CVE, severity or scan drift
time_box.rerun_rule: Any run after expiry requires a new scan and a new owner risk acceptance against that then-current scan. Unused attempts or seconds do not survive expiry.

non_precedential_boundary.serving_images: EXCLUDED; zero critical and zero high remains mandatory with no waiver.
non_precedential_boundary.future_full_suite: EXCLUDED unless a new packet obtains a then-current scan and separate time-boxed acceptance.
non_precedential_boundary.citation_rule: This record may be cited only as evidence for the exact offline pilot subject and may never justify a serving, production, training or traffic-facing exception.

signature_and_review.signature_mechanism: After independent review PASS, an immutable authorization record must quote the exact owner approval phrase and bind the committed risk-record SHA-256, packet SHA-256, source commit and approval timestamp. This draft is never amended to add a signature.

overall_residual_risk.rationale: The malicious-checkpoint vulnerability retains high impact, but the exact pilot removes attacker-controlled artifacts, inbound traffic and general internet access and bounds exposure to two short-lived offline windows. Acceptance is appropriate only under every listed control.
